QuestInfo.name: Stylist Vincent II
QuestInfo.0: Vicky is putting Vincent in charge of styling. You think this will be a disaster, but ask Vincent what his plan is anyway.
QuestInfo.1: Vincent wants you to find a hip fragrance for Vicky's audition. He wants 3 samples to try. The perfume shop is on the #b5th Floor 6th Floor Area A Music Shop#k.
QuestInfo.2: Vicky loved the fragrance Vincent chose. Guy's got a good nose, but how does he fare with fashion?

0.0: First up: a perfume to match Vicky's trendy style! You'll help me out again, right? Right?

yes.0: I knew you'd come around! Alright, you need to go to the #bfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square, get a Blue Perfume, Yellow Perfume, and Pink Perfume from the #bPerfume Shop#k and then give them to Vicky.
yes.1: You might miss the Perfume Shop since it's pretty tiny. Take the portal on the #b5th Floor 6th Floor Area A#k instead. It'll take you directly to the shop.

no.0: Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?

yes.0: Eww... Gross, what IS this? Nope, this one's disgusting too... Vincent's taste in perfume is just... AARRRGH!!
yes.1: Wait a sec, this one isn't that bad. I'll use it. Tell Vincent to keep up the good work, I guess.

npc.0: Go to the #bfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square, get a Blue Perfume, Yellow Perfume, and Pink Perfume from the #bPerfume Shop#k and then bring them back to Vicky.
npc.1: You might pass by the Perfume Shop since it's so small. Take the portal on the #b5th Floor 6th Floor Area A#k to go to the shop.
